text: We study data distillation for auto-regressive machine learning tasks, where the input and output have a strict left-to-right causal structure. More specifically, we propose Farzi, which summarizes an event sequence dataset into a small number of synthetic sequences — Farzi Data — which are optimized to maintain (if not improve) model performance compared to training on the full dataset.
